items.title: Solana Changelog: Mainnet raises block limits to 100M CUs
items.whyYouShouldCare: Raising block limits to 100 million compute units enhances Solana's scalability, potentially attracting more developers and increasing network usage.

items.title: Overview of Institutional Real World Assets on Solana
items.whyYouShouldCare: The integration of institutional real-world assets on Solana could drive liquidity and broaden the ecosystem's appeal to traditional finance.

items.title: Coinbase’s Q2 miss sparks split on Wall Street, analysts debate growth beyond crypto trading
items.whyYouShouldCare: Coinbase's performance issues may impact overall crypto market sentiment, influencing trading volumes and liquidity on platforms like Solana.
